[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Bolleon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was a member of the family [[House Bolleon]]. Bolleon was a collector of artifacts and primitive art, and at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history he journeyed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Durace]] with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[GB-3P0]], to translate the world's ancient pictographs. However, something on Durace did not want the writings to be deciphered and it [[Death/Legends|killed]] Bolleon before he could complete his translation.
